title: How Rats Outsmart MRI in Cancer Detection

scenes.text: Scientists found rats can sniff out cancer with 96% accuracy
In a 2008 study, trained rats identified lung cancer in breath samples with about 96% sensitivity.
The rats learn the task in roughly five days, far faster than many lab training programs.
